description: Typing race, 2048 and Bug Smash: calm mini-games that open while Claude Code works and tell you, session by session, when it's done.
command.installHooks: Install Claude Code hooks (optional, detects permission prompts)
config.autoOpen: Open the game automatically when Claude starts working
config.strictMode: Work first: after Claude finishes, the game locks (after a 10 second grace period) until you reply to Claude. Turn off to only pause the game.
config.focusClaude: Move the cursor to the Claude input box when the game locks
config.newsOnline: Check GitHub for new Claude Code tips (at most every 6 hours). Only the public tips file is downloaded; nothing about you is sent. When off, only the tips bundled with the extension are shown.
